description.value:
Usage etched onto armor or a creature

This rune calls to mind the forlorn nature of elves, and the beauty within it. While this rune is beautiful, sorrow is best admired from a distance, discouraging approach. Enemies within 20 feet of the rune-bearer treat all squares between them and the rune-bearer as difficult terrain.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-runesmith-assistant.pf2e-runesmith-assistant-items.Item.HA64N3BMUWe4NuxA]{Effect: Trolistri, Rune of Forlorn Sorrow}

Invocation Sorrow blots out the capacity for any other action. Each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:15] around the rune-bearer must succeed at a @Check[will|against:runesmith] throw or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round as it spends the first action of its next turn sobbing (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} on a critical failure). Regardless of the outcome, the creature is then temporarily immune to the invocation of trolistri, rune of forlorn sorrow for 1 hour.
